question.worked_solution:
First, we clear the rational expression by multiplying both sides by $4:$

$$
\begin{aligned}3a-7 & >\frac{8a+5}{4} \\ 4\cdot (3a-7) & >4\cdot (\frac{8a+5}{4}) \\ 4\cdot (3a-7) & >\cancel{4}\cdot (\frac{8a+5}{\cancel{4}}) \\ 4\cdot (3a-7) & >8a+5 \\ 12a-28 & >8a+5\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the addition and multiplication principles:

$$
\begin{aligned}12a-28 & >8a+5 \\ 12a-28-8a & >8a+5-8a \\ 4a-28 & >5 \\ 4a-28+28 & >5+28 \\ 4a & >33 \\ \frac{4a}{4} & >\frac{33}{4} \\ a & >\frac{33}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $a>\frac{33}{4}.$
